verses.1: The seer grew proud, and in one moment God caused him to forget, so that his belly was filled from his feet to his head; and in that moment he died.
verses.2: And again Nimrod grew proud, who made a fortress of brick out of his great strength; yet God brought him down.
verses.3: And again Nebuchadnezzar grew proud and said, 'There is no other king besides me, and I am the one who makes the sun rise over the earth'; and out of his great pride he spoke thus.
verses.4: And God drove him away from among men.
verses.5: And when he came to his senses, He restored him to his kingdom. Who is it that resisted Him and grew proud against God his Creator, who is not of the earth?
verses.6: And who is it that transgressed His law and His ordinance, and who is it that did not fear Him upon the earth?
verses.7: And you also, O king, do you wish to exalt yourself against your Maker? And again it will happen to you as it happened to them, that He will humble you because of your pride and bring you down to the dust of death.
verses.8: And further, into Sheol, to the edge of darkness, where there is weeping and gnashing of teeth, down below into the great and burning pit, where its burning lasts for ever.
verses.9: You also, O man of dust, who are formed of clay, you will die like those proud kings who were before you, who forsook the treasure of this world.
verses.10: But we say: you are a man, and not God; for God is the Maker of heaven and earth, and your Maker.
verses.11: And it is He who humbles the proud and exalts the lowly; and it is He who gives strength to the weak, and it is He who gives weakness to the strong.
verses.12: And it is He who gives death to the living, and it is He who raises up the dead who lie in the graves and have become dust.
verses.13: And He delivers His servants into life from the works of sin.
verses.14: O king, why do you boast in your unclean gods, which have no breath?
verses.15: God made the heavens and founded the earth and created the great sea; He established the sun and the moon and appointed the seasons and the years.
verses.16: And man grows fat in his deeds, he becomes rich and prospers until he is satisfied; and the stars of heaven also are set in place by His word.
verses.17: And He calls them all by their names, and there is nothing that exists which God does not know.
verses.18: And the angels of heaven also are those whom He commands, that they may be sent forth; and they praise His holy name, and they are sent to all the angels on behalf of those who will inherit life.
verses.19: Raphael the angel was sent to Tobit, and he saved Tobias in the land of Raguel.
verses.20: And an angel was sent to Gideon, that he might clothe him with that by which he would destroy the people; and an angel was sent from Moses the prophet when He led Israel across the Red Sea.
verses.21: For God said, 'I alone am their guide, and there is no strange god with them.'
verses.22: And He brought them up upon the strength of the earth.
verses.23: And He fed them like lambs, and sheltered them with honey from the rock, for He loved them very much.
verses.24: And to you also I gave kingship over His people, and I gave you authority over the four kingdoms, that you might keep the people and shepherd them rightly and do the will of Him who created you.
verses.25: And I made you king exceedingly, that you might love the Lord your God; for above all else I chose you and made you king.
verses.26: And you also, O righteous one, love the Lord your God exceedingly, as He loved you; and trust in all His pasture, and do the will of God, that your days may be long upon the earth and that your descendants may be with you.
verses.27: And He will rise up for you against all your enemies, and He will establish you upon all your throne, and He will spread His wings over your head.
verses.28: For if you know, God chose you as He chose Saul from the children of Israel, and made him king over Israel His people, while he was seeking the donkeys of his father; and he sat upon the throne with Samuel the prophet.
verses.29: And He gave him a great portion among his brethren, and said to him, 'Behold, from this day the Lord of the land has made you king over His people; rule His people.'
verses.30: And He showed them: to those who do good, with good, and to those who do evil, with evil; for God has appointed you over them, that you may kill and give life.
verses.31: And to those who do good, that you may reward them with good, and to those who do evil, that you may repay them with evil; for God has appointed you over all that you desire, that you may do His will, whether in punishing or in giving life.
verses.32: And you also, do the will of God at all times and at every hour, that He may do your will in all that you desire and in all that you ask, while you walk uprightly before Him; for you also are His servant, you who belong to Him who rules all, who is in the heights.
verses.33: And for him who has no one to judge him, He Himself judges all.
verses.34: For him who has no one to appoint him, He Himself appoints all.
verses.35: For him who has no one to humble him, He Himself humbles all.
verses.36: For him who has no one to deliver him, He Himself delivers all.
verses.37: For him who has no one to make him, He Himself makes all; and there is nothing that escapes from His hand, for the governance of heaven and earth is with Him.
verses.38: And there is nothing hidden before His eyes, but all is revealed before Him.
verses.39: And He sees all, and there is nothing that He does not see; He hears the prayer of him who prays to Him, and He does not reject his prayer; for He created man in His image and in His likeness.
verses.40: And He sustains all from His storehouse, which is unfailing; for He is the King who reigns for ever.
